name: Intravesical BCG - induction (6 weekly instillations)
cyclesNote: Induction is a single 6-week course: one intravesical instillation weekly for 6 consecutive weeks (encoded as a 7-day cycle x 6). Start no sooner than 2-3 weeks after TURBT to allow mucosal healing and avoid intravasation.

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

biomarkers.note: Intravesical BCG is a live attenuated Mycobacterium bovis immunotherapy for high-risk (and selected intermediate-risk) non-muscle-invasive urothelial carcinoma after complete TURBT. No molecular biomarker gates its use.

supportiveCare: Confirm no gross hematuria, traumatic catheterization, active UTI, or febrile illness before each instillation; hold BCG until resolved (risk of systemic BCG infection).
Retain the instillation in the bladder for about 2 hours with position changes, then void seated; disinfect voided urine for 6 hours per institutional policy.
Manage cystitis symptoms with anticholinergics/analgesics; escalate persistent high fever or systemic symptoms to evaluation for BCG sepsis (may need anti-tuberculous therapy).
monitoring: symptom review before each weekly instillation (dysuria, fever, hematuria)
cystoscopy + cytology at first surveillance (about 3 months) to assess response

doseModificationRules.condition: severe local (grade >= 2 cystitis) or any systemic BCG reaction
doseModificationRules.text: Hold BCG until symptoms resolve; treat symptomatic cystitis and consider a reduced dose or fluoroquinolone. Discontinue and evaluate for systemic BCG infection (fever, sepsis, granulomatous organ involvement). Physician decides.

drugs.name: BCG (intravesical)
drugs.notes: One reconstituted vial instilled intravesically weekly for 6 weeks (induction). Dose is one strain-defined vial: TICE approximately 50 mg per vial, Connaught/Danish 1331 approximately 81 mg, RIVM approximately 2 x 10^8 to 3 x 10^9 CFU. Reconstitute in about 50 mL preservative-free saline. Strain and unit potency are not interchangeable across products; follow the specific product label. Own wording; standard reference dose.

provenance.locator: Principles of Intravesical Therapy - BCG induction (6 weekly)
